- **Shop UX** — QR newsletter opt-in now defaults to unchecked (genuine consent) with centered UI.
- **Narrative published** — "The checklist that lets you do nothing" (Do Nothing Society) + updated "The chain holds" (Field Signals #7).
- **Event prep** — Dual Tech Summit QR tooling finalized; sample bags prepped for Onsen gathering.
- **Routing fix** — GAS proxy cutover resolves latent 401 errors and improves cross-border reliability.
- **Roadmap** — Edgar extraction plan and execution roadmap conventions locked in.
